title: Zomato
author: VIVEK BARI
body:
The shortlisting is done on resume basis.This was followed by two interview rounds-both of them mainly based on problem-solving and operational thinking.

Interview Round 1 - Problem Solving & Guesstimates

The first interview focused on real-time operations scenarios, such as process optimization. I was also asked a guesstimate(no of dark stores in gurgaon) , with much more focus on structure, assumptions, and logical flow than the exact number. The interviewer briefly touched on resume points to understand my approach and thought process.

Interview Round 2 - Business Cases & Resume Deep Dive

The second interview included more focused business case questions, prioritization challenges, and situational problem statements. He asked about my internships, critical decisions made, problems encountered, and how I justify them. This round evaluated clarity, analytical thinking, and ability to handle ambiguity under pressure.
